headline: Transfer rumors, news: Manchester United eye move for Ivan Toney
description: Manchester United are looking to improve their attack by signing Al Ahli's Ivan Toney. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Oli McBurnie is Hull's 'Braveheart,' says Sergej Jakirovic after Brighton win
description: Hull manager Sergej Jakirovic has likened striker Oli McBurnie to Scottish warrior William Wallace, as depicted by Mel Gibson in the 1995 film Braveheart.

headline: Guimarães: Newcastle fans that booed me 'can't delete my history with the club'
description: Bruno Guimarães has told the Newcastle fans who booed his return to St James Park that they "cannot delete the history I have with the club."

headline: Man United's heavy Liverpool loss didn't tell us anything new; epic Barça comeback
description: Pochettino's debut as Man United manager didn't tell us anything we didn't already know when it came to the scale of rebuild required.

headline: David Raya won't need surgery - Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta
description: Mikel Arteta has said David Raya's shoulder injury is better than first feared and that the goalkeeper will not require surgery.

headline: Man United to appeal Leny Yoro red card against Liverpool - sources
description: Manchester United have notified the Football Association of their intention to appeal Leny Yoro's red card in the 4-0 defeat to Liverpool, sources have told ESPN.
